request:
镜头 s30：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：只做专业化补全（没有选择风格预设）。保持导演意图里写到的外观，不添加任何胶片、机身、调色或导演风格。
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持，跟拍，晃动。指挥大厅里警报灯一闪一闪，调度员们乱成一片。宋念戴着耳机站在操作台前，慢慢抬起头，看向大屏中央那枚红色镜头。环境声：警报声、此起彼伏听不清的呼叫声。
情绪：frantic, tense, foreboding
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld follow with a nervous shake
景深与虚实：Natural depth of field; Nian sharp, the operators around her blurred by motion.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Raw verité in the underground city's command hall during the Jupiter crisis: Nian, 33, in a dark grey dispatcher uniform with a headset, stands at her console among frantic operators, alarm lights pulsing, looking up at the red lens high on the display wall. Blocking lock: Nian stands at her console at frame centre-left, operators move around her at frame left and right, the display wall with the red lens fills the upper background.
Picture 2: Nian (Song's daughter, dispatch engineer, 33 in 2075, 36 in 2078) (character reference; role: the daughter, now grown up). A Chinese woman in her mid-thirties, dispatch engineer of an underground city: straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind her ears with short side-swept bangs, calm guarded tired eyes, faint lines, a round face grown lean. Dark grey dispatcher uniform jacket with a high collar, a light headset around her neck.
Picture 3: the administration command hall (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the administration command centre of an underground city: a tiered control hall with rows of consoles and operators seen from behind, a giant dark display wall showing only abstract maps and graphs, and high in the middle of the wall a single round red-glowing camera lens of the central AI. Cold blue-white light.
Picture 4: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
本镜头没有台词。

现场环境声：blaring alarms, overlapping indistinct Mandarin radio calls, footsteps
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[ours/cam-verite-follow] 机位：纪实手持跟拍
[rules/move/nervous-handheld] move
[ours/pace-doc] 节奏：纪录片的呼吸
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 9.0s, 24fps, fly-on-the-wall documentary footage, shoulder-mounted handheld verite camera with small late reframings, natural depth of field, cold blue-white command-hall light crossed by pulsing red alarm light; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium shot, shoulder-mounted handheld documentary camera, one continuous handheld follow with a nervous shake, opening on Nian at her console and drifting slowly right and tilting slightly up to end on a slightly tighter medium shot with her face and the red lens above her in the same frame; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: Nian at her console frame centre-left with her back half to camera, two operators crossing frame left and frame right in the mid-ground, the dark display wall and its single red lens high in the upper background. Start: Nian stands bent slightly over her console, head down, one hand flat on the console edge, the headset clamped over her ears, the console's blue glow under her chin and red alarm light sweeping across her cheek. Middle: she slowly straightens her back and lifts her chin, her shoulders squaring, while an operator hurries through the foreground from frame right to frame left and briefly blocks her; the handheld camera reacts half a beat late and reframes to keep her face, the shake trembling a little more as the alarms repeat. End: her head is fully up, eyes fixed on the red lens at the centre of the display wall, lips slightly parted, her hand still on the console, the operators around her still churning, the frame settling on her upturned face held in red and blue light. Mood: frantic, tense, foreboding. Blur: Nian's face and the headset stay sharp, the operators around her smear into motion blur and fall out of focus, the display wall and the red lens softening into a dark panel with one small glowing point above her. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Blaring alarms repeating in short cycles, overlapping indistinct Mandarin radio calls and shouts from the consoles, hurried footsteps on the metal floor plates, the crackle and hiss of a headset close to the microphone, low console beeps, an occasional metal clang, room tone of a large closed hall; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
